verdicts.reason: Both reflow the same way. In both, the 'Live music' tagline is jammed against the left-aligned 'Saturday 21 June' block, which clashes with the centred header. The phone floats off-axis and leaves dead space on the left above the CTA, and the QR placeholder sits next to the URL line. B is worse: the pill gaps are uneven (TASTINGS is pushed right, away from ALL AGES), the phone is shoved toward the right edge, and the URL line and QR box drop down almost onto the legal text, so the bottom looks cramped. A keeps even pill spacing and more breathing room above the fine print.
